rows.grounds: compound of pātrī (vessel) and anna (food); objects to be offered
food-balls or lumps offered in ritual
prescribes the act of presenting offerings

items.question: What specific offerings must be presented to the brahmin following proper ritual confirmation?
premises: The ritual procedure has been confirmed as properly completed.
Vessel-foods constitute one category of offering.
Lumps or balls constitute another category of offering.
The brahmin is the designated recipient of these offerings.
items.inference: Therefore, one should offer both vessel-foods and lumps to the brahmin.
uncertainties: The exact composition or preparation of pātrī+annāni and piṇḍān is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should offer vessel-foods and lumps to the brahmin.
